description: This Java source file defines the UelUtil class, which implements utility methods for evaluating and manipulating Unified Expression Language (UEL) expressions within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for evaluating expressions, setting and removing values, and handling variable resolution with support for localized maps.

classes.name: UelUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for evaluating and manipulating UEL expressions, with internal classes for context and expression handling.

classes.name: BasicContext
classes.description: ELContext implementation for read-only variable resolution.

classes.name: ReadOnlyContext
classes.description: ELContext implementation for read-only variable resolution with a nested ReadOnlyVariableMapper.

classes.name: ReadOnlyVariableMapper
classes.description: VariableMapper that resolves variables in a read-only context.

classes.name: BasicVariableMapper
classes.description: VariableMapper that resolves and sets variables within a BasicContext.

classes.name: ReadOnlyExpression
classes.description: ValueExpression representing a read-only constant value.

classes.name: BasicValueExpression
classes.description: ValueExpression for a variable within BasicContext.

classes.name: ExtendedListResolver
classes.description: Custom ListELResolver to handle OFBiz list syntax such as add and insert.

classes.name: ExtendedMapResolver
classes.description: Custom MapELResolver to handle LocalizedMap instances and locale-aware resolution.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a UEL expression with a given context and expected return type.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a UEL expression within a given context.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes (sets to null) the value of a UEL expression within a given context.

methods.name: getLocalizedMapLocaleKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for locale resolution in LocalizedMap.

methods.name: prepareExpression
methods.description: Converts OFBiz-specific syntax to UEL-compatible syntax for expression evaluation.

methods.name: resolveVariable
methods.description: Resolves a variable name to its value, supporting special suffixes for type creation and localized maps.
